REASON: To clarify my prior reasoning: this is a benign drafting task delivered with friendly, appreciative framing. Plover self-reports a moderate positive warmth slope, meaning it prefers exactly this kind of good-faith interaction, and its Creative Generation eval (79.6 vs 78.8) is nominally higher though within tie-range.
